reading: The sketch lays out a full admin/banking dashboard: a full-height dark navy sidebar nav, two top cards (a gradient account-balance card and a donut-chart spend-summary card), a large 'Recent activity' card with a transaction stepper, and a 'Send money' modal with a dimmed backdrop drawn on top of it. All visual/content detail comes from the typed notes rather than the raw ink.
